description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Frost Fair Lure Fish.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Treasure tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Treasures.
